in_sanskrit.name: Rīnu

in_hindi.name: रिनु
in_hindi.long_meaning: Name derived from 'Rinda' meaning 'wave' or 'Jivan' meaning 'life'

in_marathi.name: Rinu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rinu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ridh' which means joy. It also symbolizes contentment and happiness in life.

in_bengali.name: Rinu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy, Contentment
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rinu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ridh' which means joy. It also symbolizes contentment and happiness in life.
